positioning.note: Drag/drop UI, template-driven execution. Not a graph compiler.

items.title: Lock positioning: Template Tuner (not graph compiler)
acceptance: UI + docs never imply arbitrary graph execution

items.title: Remove/disable non-semantic nodes (Signal/Output) or label ignored
acceptance: Users cannot create nodes that don't affect execution (or sees explicit 'ignored')

items.title: Edges policy: decorative-only or disable connect
acceptance: Connections never imply logic; preview states 'connections ignored' if enabled

items.title: Restrict indicator/filter options to engine-supported set
acceptance: No unsupported options available in Template Tuner mode

items.title: Execution Preview panel (resolved template + params + config)
acceptance: Preview equals submitted payload; shows ignored inputs list

items.title: Strict mapping rules (no silent fallback)
acceptance: Unsupported graph -> deterministic error; supported -> deterministic payload

items.title: Bias-safe Strategy Lab execution defaults (force next_open)
acceptance: same_close not available or requires explicit opt-in warning

items.title: Backtest invariants tests
acceptance: No-lookahead, cost monotonicity, accounting consistency tests pass

items.title: E2E smoke: build -> preview -> run -> summary
acceptance: Runs in docker and produces artifacts (report + screenshots)
